item.title: Can exercise be harmful? Mini-heart study offers new insights
item.description: Exercise is often called medicine, but like medication, more is not always better. Researchers examine what constitutes excessive exercise.

item.title: Wearable AI predicts prolonged sitting in women with chronic pelvic pain
item.description: Researchers at Mount Sinai developed an AI method using wearable device data to forecast extended sitting periods in women with chronic pelvic pain.

item.title: When Imposter Syndrome Returned, I Knew It Was Time to Retire
item.description: Imposter syndrome is common among young doctors, but this 35-year veteran saw his new anxiety as a sign to retire.

item.title: Multimorbidity found in most Japanese home care patients
item.description: As Japan's population ages, more older adults receive home-based medical care, with physicians visiting patients who have difficulty leaving home.
